profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at County of Santa Clara
profile.summary:
Over 15 years of experience in software development and automation testing with CI/CD environment. Familiar with Cloud infrastructure deployment, including networking and Kubernetes.  Have been working on large scale and real time software. Very proficient in programming languages, especially Java, JavaScript, C++. Strong knowledge of object oriented designs and database abstraction. Quick learner and adapt well to new teams.

Worked well with teams and have been technical lead of teams.
 
Cloud Infrastructure: 
•	Oracle cloud infrastructure deployment with Virtual cloud networking, cloud instances, and Kubernetes using Terraform and Helm charts.

CI/CD: 
•	Jenkins pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes.
Java: 
•	Dropwizard micro service to provide REST API for OCI Platform Test Automation.
•	Developed client/server applications and GUI (Dashboard) using Spring Frameworks, Spring Boot, JSP, JSON, XML, XSLT, AJAX, JQuery, JQGrid, JavaScript and Maven.
•	Developed test automation frameworks with Maven and Junit.
C++/C: 
•	Experienced in various C++ applications with in-depth understanding multi-threading, synchronization, and socket programming. 
•	Proficient in C++ with strong knowledge of OOA and OOD, data abstraction, inheritance, polymorphisms, and STL template library.
Script: 
•	Python, ANT, Perl, Go and Shell scripts.
Database: 
•	Oracle DBMS, MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL
•	Proficient in SQL, RDBMS, and knowledge of database schema design.
Tools and developing environment: 
•	Software: Maven, Graddle, Apache, Tomcat, GIT, CVS, SVN, BitBucket. 
•	Operating Systems: Unix, Linux, Mac and Windows. 
US Patent:
•	Patent No. 9270528, Systems and Methods of Provisioning Data Storage and Runtime Configuration in Telecommunications Systems and Devices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Peoplesoft: supporting Payroll and Employee Services.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
•	Cloud Notification Service:  using Terraform to deploy Oracle cloud infrastructure with Kubernetes, and oracle Email/SMS service to allow Oracle products to send Email/SMS notifications to customers.
•	OCI Platform test automation framework.

•	OCI Platform Test micro service to enable OCI platform automation framework.

•	OCI Platform Identity simulated micro service to test OCI Identity integration with Oracle IDCS.

•	Public Cloud Infrastructure preflight tool (Dashboard) for developers to test OCI clusters before committing changes to official product: Spring Frameworks server application server with Java Spring Framewoks, JQuery, Jqgrid, JavaScript, AJAX. 

•	Developed Jenkins automation frameworks/pipelines to install OCI clusters on Xen Hypervisor enabled servers, using docker containers to execute the pipelines.

•	Designed and implemented database for QA to view and analyze test reports and integrated with JIRA for bugs reporting.

•	Developed administrative dashboard for OCI clusters of more than 100 for QA to test Oracle Cloud Services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Staging build and automation testing process using Jenkins Continuous Integration.
•	Analyzing telephony network and generating detailed reports of the telephony network traffic.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-- Session Border Control -- Local Element Management System -- C++ server application and web application (JSP with Spring Frameworks, Ajax and Javascript) to enable configurations of Session Border Control network.
-- Element Management System (EMS) -- Design and implement a server type application (C++) to control multiple element applications in a redundancy network of the Call Control SoftSwitch. Having strong knowledge in handling fail over scenarios, controlling active/standby (life cycle), and discovery of element applications. Worked in team of more than 10 people and led a few core features of the application.
-- Data Provisioning for Element Applications -- EMS application to retrieve data from database and provision (data synchronization) for element applications.
-- Directory Service Engine -- application to store and retrieve phone number directories from database.
-- Diagnostics Manager -- Technical Lead for an application to collect debugging information from network elements using SCTP mechanism to avoid performance load and network congestion.  Managed a team of 4 people in technical development.
-- File Based Provisioning -- Technical Lead for EMS feature to capture provisioning data into files and bring up element applications using files.  This optimized the provisioning time and eliminated failures from network latency.
